loaders_required.KTX2Loader: all 28 textures are KTX2/Basis (KHR_texture_basisu is in extensionsRequired). setTranscoderPath('/basis/') and detectSupport(renderer) before loading; the transcoder is served from apps/public/public/basis/.
loaders_required.DRACOLoader: geometry is Draco compressed. setDecoderPath('/draco/'); the decoder is served from apps/public/public/draco/.

lightmap.note: glTF has no lightmap slot, so baked GI rides in occlusion. On load promote aoMap -> lightMap and set colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace: the atlas is normalised then sRGB-encoded for precision, because linear 8-bit puts the room near value 13 and bands.
lightmap.intensity_note: 4.6597 is carried over from the previous bake and has NOT been re-derived against this rebuild. It has not been shown to be wrong, and it has not been shown to be right.

textures.normal_maps: UASTC - ETC1S quantises a direction field hard enough to facet across large flat walls
textures.everything_else: ETC1S - on the 4K atlas it is 1.1MB against 7.1MB for UASTC, on smooth low-frequency light
textures.BROKEN_2026_08_26: FOUR images have non-multiple-of-four dimensions and therefore FAIL their compressed upload at runtime: founder_portrait_graded (766x1024), kartikeya_holo_tex (745x725), lucky_holo_tex (1024x607), gayatri_holo_tex (1024x729). Chrome logs 'THREE.KTX2Loader: ETC1S and UASTC textures should use multiple-of-four dimensions' followed by ~80 glCompressedTexSubImage/glTexStorage GL_INVALID_OPERATION per load. Visible consequence: the founder's portrait and ALL THREE project site plans render with no artwork. Fix in the encode step, not in code - pad or resample each to a multiple of four before ktx2 encoding.

not_lightmapped: Instanced ornament (153 anthemions, 54 balusters, 11 capitals, 6 newels) and props/emitters. A lightmap needs per-placement UVs, which would cost the instancing that keeps the upload at 214k vertices.
rebuild: gltf-transform dedup _raw.glb _a.glb && gltf-transform prune _a.glb _b.glb && gltf-transform copy _b.glb ex/scene.gltf
gltf-transform copy ex/scene.gltf _k.glb && gltf-transform draco _k.glb interior_hall.glb

known_false_positives: VALUE_NOT_IN_LIST 'image/ktx2' (x28) and IMAGE_UNRECOGNIZED_FORMAT (x28): this validator build predates KHR_texture_basisu. The extension declares mimeType image/ktx2 exactly as the spec requires, and is listed in extensionsUsed and extensionsRequired.
UNUSED_OBJECT on 28 images and 218 bufferViews: they are reached only through KHR_texture_basisu and KHR_draco_mesh_compression, which the validator cannot follow, so it cannot see the references.
validation.real_but_negligible: One primitive carries a TEXCOORD_1 its material does not sample - a single unused attribute, left in place rather than hand-editing the buffer.

station_rig.shipped: STATION_Sn -> { HOLO_Sn, projector_Sn -> projlens_Sn, TURNTABLE_Sn -> { table_base_Sn, table_inlay_Sn, table_top_Sn } }
